Q9019.reason: Repeated sprints raise plasma ammonia from AMP deamination, and the downstream purine products hypoxanthine and uric acid also rise; urea and creatine are not products of ADP degradation.

Q9020.reason: The deed was signed and delivered, so Kathy took the condo by survivorship as a tenant by the entirety, outside the estate; the prenuptial waiver only bars her estate claims, so the will governs the rest.

Q9021.reason: Custom shutters screwed into the window frames were fixtures that passed with the home absent a contrary agreement, and the seller's later removal and repair does not change that.
